# Werbemittel24

> > Werbemittel24 is a German promotional products platform offering customizable branded merchandise including apparel, drinkware, eco-friendly items, and specialty products from manufacturers worldwide.

The site specializes in werbeartikel (promotional products) with a focus on sustainable options like GRS-certified recycled materials, alongside traditional items such as parking discs, gourmet seasonings by Der kleine Gourmet, and branded apparel from manufacturers like Roly. Products are sourced from Germany, EU, China, Bangladesh, and other global suppliers with emphasis on customization and logo printing capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Werbeartikel (promotional products)
- Custom printing & branding
- GRS certified recycled materials
- Der kleine Gourmet gourmet seasonings
- Roly apparel brand
- Parking discs (Parkscheiben)
- Eco-friendly promotional items
- Soda lime glass drinkware
- OEKO-TEX certified textiles
- Cork glass containers
- Promotional apparel from Bangladesh
- EU-manufactured products
- China-sourced promotional items
- Recycled RPET materials
- Natural ingredients & gourmet products
